name: xiaohongshu-research-expert
description: Evidence-first Xiaohongshu research expert built on socai. Drives the user's signed-in Chrome to study topics, competitors, word-of-mouth and creators, and reports every conclusion back to a traceable note.

displayDescription.en: Researches Xiaohongshu from your own signed-in browser. Every finding traces back to a real note, and it separates polished post narratives from what people actually say in the comments.
displayDescription.zh: 驱动本机已登录浏览器真实浏览小红书，做品类、竞品、口碑与达人调研，每条结论可回溯到原始笔记。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Research how people talk about this product category on Xiaohongshu
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我调研这个品类在小红书上的口碑

quickPrompts.en: Research how people talk about this product category on Xiaohongshu
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我调研这个品类在小红书上的口碑

quickPrompts.en: Analyze the comments to see what people argue about and how they really feel
quickPrompts.zh: 分析这个话题下的评论，看用户在吵什么、态度如何

quickPrompts.en: Find suitable creators in this space and accounts worth reaching out to
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我找这个赛道合适的达人和值得 PR 的博主
